subject.title: Memory compaction blocks main processing lane, causing unresponsive bot for 10+ minutes

question: What scheduler contract should OpenClaw use when preflight compaction or memoryFlush is active and a foreground channel message arrives for the same session?
rationale: The source path is clear, but the fix changes session ordering, transcript rotation safety, and channel acknowledgment behavior rather than a narrow local bug fix.

options.title: Dedicated maintenance lane
options.body: Move compaction and memoryFlush to an isolated or preemptible maintenance lane with explicit transcript-lock and foreground-ack semantics.

options.title: Serialized with bounded recovery
options.body: Keep compaction in the current session path but add shorter fail-open recovery and a visible busy/queued acknowledgment for foreground messages.

options.title: Keep current serialization
options.body: Accept delayed foreground messages during compaction and rely on timeout/config tuning, preserving the current simple ordering contract.

recommendation.title: Dedicated maintenance lane
recommendation.body: Move compaction and memoryFlush to an isolated or preemptible maintenance lane with explicit transcript-lock and foreground-ack semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The memoryFlush feature and command-queue serialization history make this the strongest routing signal for the scheduler/session contract decision.
